name: sky-score-mobile
description: Capacitor wrapper for Sky Score — bundles the web app as native iOS + Android apps via Codemagic.

scripts.build:assets: npm run render:assets && npx capacitor-assets generate --assetPath assets
scripts.sync: npm run build:web && npx cap sync
scripts.android: npm run sync && npx cap open android
scripts.ios: npm run sync && npx cap open ios
scripts.android:run: npm run sync && npx cap run android
